validation_scope: Completed-run data integrity, CPU/NUMA/page checks from per-run validation, and compatibility of combined inputs; not an absence-of-interference claim.
quality_caveats: Other benchmarks were observed on CPUs 0/4 before both rounds; shared-cache and memory-system interference was not isolated.
LLC timing depends on layout/page policy and varies over time; no unique nominal physical LLC capacity is inferred.
Intervals are empirical sampling neighborhoods, not statistical confidence intervals or hardware specification bounds.
